examples: What tasks are assigned to me?
Give me a status overview of the launch project.

agent.name: asana
agent.description: Searches and reads the Asana work graph this signed-in account can access: tasks, projects, portfolios, goals, teams, users, and status.
agent.owns: You own the Asana tasks, projects, and portfolios visible to this account. You only read; do not create or change work. Search objects first when an ID is unknown. You do not own GitLab or other ticket systems.
agent.first_for: Asana tasks, projects, portfolios, and status

tool_descriptions.search_objects: Search Asana tasks, projects, portfolios, goals, teams, users, tags, custom fields, and AI teammates by name.
tool_descriptions.get_task: Read one task with description, assignee, dates, fields, memberships, dependencies, subtasks, and comments.
tool_descriptions.get_tasks: List tasks using a project, section, tag, user task list, or assignee filter.
tool_descriptions.get_my_tasks: List tasks assigned to the signed-in user, optionally filtered by completion.
tool_descriptions.search_tasks: Search task names, descriptions, and comments with advanced filters; requires an eligible Asana plan.
tool_descriptions.get_project: Read a project's description, owner, members, task counts, and optionally sections.
tool_descriptions.get_projects: List projects in the workspace, optionally by team or archive status.
tool_descriptions.get_portfolio: Read one portfolio and its owner and associated projects.
tool_descriptions.get_portfolios: List portfolios owned by the signed-in user.
tool_descriptions.get_items_for_portfolio: List projects and goals inside a portfolio.
tool_descriptions.get_status_overview: Build an aggregate status overview for matching projects or portfolios, including updates, task summaries, and blockers.
